# GN Scales

> GN Scales is a performance marketing agency: we run Meta, Google and TikTok ads and build the landing pages they send customers to.

GN Scales is run by its two co-founders, Nikoloz Peikrishvili and Giorgi Lomidze, who do the work themselves: no account managers, nothing outsourced. They sharpen a business's offer, make the ad creative, build the landing page and run the Meta, Google and TikTok campaigns as one system, with AI agents, automation and app builds as add-ons. GN Scales works with small businesses in any industry, in the United States first and also in Georgia, where it is based (Rustavi). All prices are published in USD on the pricing page. Clients pay their ad spend directly to Meta, Google or TikTok, and GN Scales never marks it up. It is taking its first five clients now and publishes no client results yet.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://gnscales.com/services.html): Meta, Google and TikTok ads, ad creative and landing pages, plus AI agents, automation and app builds, all planned, made and run by the same two marketers.
- [Meta ads management](https://gnscales.com/meta-ads.html): Facebook and Instagram ads made and run by GN Scales, with the landing page and tracking included and no markup on ad spend.
- [Google Ads management](https://gnscales.com/google-ads.html): Google Search and Shopping campaigns for small and local businesses, with the landing page and call tracking.
- [Landing pages](https://gnscales.com/landing-pages.html): hand-coded landing pages written to match Meta and Google ads, with no page builder, no plugins and no monthly fee, owned by the client.
- [AI agents](https://gnscales.com/ai-agents.html): an AI receptionist trained on the business that answers questions, qualifies leads and books appointments around the clock, on the website or in DMs. A Crown add-on.
- [Automation](https://gnscales.com/automation.html): instant lead follow-up, CRM sync, review requests and reports that run without anyone touching them. A Crown add-on.
- [App builds](https://gnscales.com/app-builds.html): custom apps and internal tools built around how a business runs. A Crown add-on, from $14,993, with care from $691 a month.

## Industries

- [Industries we serve](https://gnscales.com/industries.html): one method (sharpen the offer, make the ads, build the page, run the campaigns) for local and home services, ecommerce, B2B and professional services, clinics, real estate, automotive, jewelry, hospitality, education and more. What changes by industry is the offer, the platform mix and the math.

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://gnscales.com/pricing.html): Launch is $1,618 a month plus a one-time $2,264 setup (one ad platform, Meta or Google). Growth is $3,287 a month plus a one-time $3,393 setup (Meta and Google). Crown is from $4,612 a month plus a one-time setup from $7,628 (Meta, Google and TikTok, and a full website). Prices are in USD, every partnership starts with three months, and ad spend is paid straight to the platforms, never marked up.

## Guides

- [Guides](https://gnscales.com/guides.html): plain guides to paid ads for small businesses, by the two founders of GN Scales.
- [How much should I spend on ads? Start with your break-even](https://gnscales.com/break-even-ad-spend.html): work out break-even ad spend from job value, margin and close rate, with a worked example and a free calculator.
- [Meta ads vs Google Ads: which should your business start with?](https://gnscales.com/meta-vs-google-ads.html): how searching and scrolling differ, what each platform is good for, which to start with, and when to run both.
